This means that even though I have a high priority at y, the competition is likely fierce, and I might not get accepted immediately. School w is my least preferred option among the top 3, but I have the highest priority there. This means that if I end up proposing to w, I am very likely to be accepted.

Therefore, I will rank the schools according to my true preferences, trusting the algorithm to work in my favor.
